description:
Music to Unwind | Surbahar Instrumental | 3 Hours

If your shoulders are still up around your ears from today — this is where you put the day down. Three hours of deep, resonant surbahar to help your body unwind in the evening: after work, over dinner, reading, or the last quiet hour before bed.

This is rest music for staying awake and letting go — not sleep music. Play it low in the background and let the day dissolve.

What you'll hear:
• Slow surbahar (the deeper, larger cousin of the sitar) — long resonant notes with space between phrases
• A low tanpura drone holding the room steady
• No percussion, no buildup, no interruptions for 3 hours

Best for:
• Decompressing after a long work day
• Evening wind-down while reading or cooking
• Slowing a busy mind before your night routine
• Quiet background for dinner or conversation

Press play. Put the day down.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — slow Indian classical surbahar in Raga Yaman, deep resonant plucked strings with long meend slides and spacious pauses, low tanpura drone, no percussion, 55–60 BPM, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: SHORT one-liner per banked 2026-07-05 default. 'Slow' allowed (deep-rest lane exemption). Verify clip 1 genuinely calm BEFORE extending. 2-3 min clips → loop/merge to 180 min in post. LOG THE ACTUAL USED PROMPT + video_id after publish (new store rule).
